interactive.welcome: Daily Agent · Enter a log; /recent to view logs; /connections to analyze links; /exit to quit
terminal.link:
Send /link {code} in Telegram.
The pairing code expires in 10 minutes and can only be used once.
telegram.start: Welcome to Daily Agent. Messages pass through Telegram. Normal text is stored as a log, redacted locally, and analyzed by GLM. First run `daily-agent link-telegram` in Terminal, then send `/link CODE` here.
telegram.linked: Pairing successful. You can now send logs directly.
telegram.invalid_pairing: The pairing code is invalid, expired, or already used. Generate a new one in Terminal.
telegram.not_linked: Not paired yet. Generate a pairing code in Terminal, then send `/link CODE`.
telegram.help:
Plain text or `/log TEXT`: save and analyze
/private TEXT: save without sending to GLM
/recent: recent logs
/connections: analyze connections
/delete ID: delete a log
/export: export JSON
/privacy: privacy information
telegram.privacy: Current version: original text is stored in plaintext SQLite. Phone numbers, emails, ID numbers, bank cards, and IP addresses are redacted before GLM calls. Telegram messages still pass through Telegram servers. Do not send passwords or other highly sensitive information.
telegram.private_saved: Saved in no-upload mode. GLM was not called.
telegram.analysis_pending: Saved, but AI analysis is not complete.
telegram.truncated: …Output was too long and has been truncated
analysis.need_two_logs: At least two logs are required to analyze connections.
